resources.string: Add YouTube playlists, subscriptions and history from ZIP, CSV, JSON or HTML

Select a Takeout ZIP containing YouTube playlists, subscriptions and history, an extracted playlist or subscriptions CSV, or watch-history/search-history JSON or HTML. Choose JSON when exporting history for reliable dates. Include playlist metadata CSV files in the ZIP to retain playlist titles and original links.
Local playlists use a (Takeout) suffix, including empty playlists. Re-imports append missing video occurrences and skip matching subscription and history entries. Existing playlist order, channel settings and video details are kept. Original playlist links are also bookmarked when provided. Titles may be unavailable for playlist videos.
Import runs on this device. Select an export under 256 MiB without uploaded video files.
Takeout import queued or running. Progress is shown in Backup and restore settings.
Added %1$d local playlists with %2$d videos, %5$d playlist bookmarks, %6$d subscriptions, %3$d watch events and %7$d searches. Skipped %4$d duplicate or unavailable entries.
